train_rsl_rl_agent: train a PPO agent using RSL-RL for a specified MuJoCo Playground environment
get_rl_config: get the RSL-RL configuration for a given MuJoCo Playground environment name
run_play_only_rollout: run a play-only rollout with a trained model and render the result as a video
resume_training_from_checkpoint: resume training from a previously saved checkpoint by specifying run name and checkpoint number
run_multi_gpu_training: run distributed multi-GPU training for a MuJoCo Playground environment
